name: Taking Your Own Life
overview: Scripture clearly affirms the sanctity of human life, emphasizing that God holds every soul in His hand and requires accountability for the shedding of life, whether by man or beast (Genesis 9:5; Job 12:10). The commandment 'Thou shalt not kill' (Exodus 20:13) underscores the divine prohibition against taking life unjustly, including one's own. Wisdom literature warns against premature death through folly or wickedness (Ecclesiastes 7:17), while the gospel of Jesus Christ offers hope and purpose amid life's trials (Mark 1:1; James 1:2), encouraging believers to trust God's sovereign plan rather than despair.
